dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: How the platform is doing: people, learning and what's waiting for review.

problems.order: The start date must be on or before the end date.
problems.tooLong: Choose a range of 400 days or less.

top.title: Courses with the most learners
top.emptyBody: Courses appear here once learners enroll.

courses.title: Courses
courses.description: Every course on the platform. Open one to see its figures and learners.
courses.noMatchesBody: Try other words or another status.
courses.emptyBody: Courses appear here as soon as someone creates one.

course.description: Enrollment, completion and exam figures, and the people enrolled.

items.title: Items
items.empty: This course has no items yet.

enrollments.title: Enrollments
enrollments.emptyBody: Learners appear here when they enroll.
enrollments.removeBody: They lose access to the course. Their progress and exam attempts are kept, so nothing is lost if they enroll again.

reject.reasonHint: The owner sees this. Say what to change. {{length}}/{{max}}

errors.required: Give a reason so the owner knows what to change.

course.approveBody: It appears in the catalog right away and learners can enroll.
course.rejectBody: The course goes back to its owner with your reason, and they can edit and submit it again.
course.rejected: Course rejected. The owner can see your reason.

revision.approveBody: They apply to the live course right away. Learners keep their progress on content that stays.
revision.rejectBody: The live course stays as it is. The owner sees your reason and can change and resubmit.
revision.rejected: Changes rejected. The owner can see your reason.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Courses waiting to be published and changes to published courses, oldest first.
moderation.emptyBody: You're all caught up. New submissions appear here.

review.description: Check the details and content, including exam answers, before you decide.
review.notPending: This course isn't waiting for review anymore, so there's nothing to decide.

video.title: YouTube title: {{title}}
video.unavailable: YouTube reports this video as unavailable.

revision.title: Changes to “{{title}}”
revision.stale: The live course changed after these changes were submitted, so they can't be applied. Reject them with a reason so the owner can update and resubmit.
revision.alreadyDecided: Someone has already reviewed these changes.

decided.approved: These changes were approved and are live.

revision.treeHint: The course as learners will see it once approved. New modules and items are marked.
revision.reorderedModules: The order of the modules changes.
revision.reorderedItems: The order of the items in this module changes.

users.title: Users
users.description: Everyone with an account. Open someone to change their role or suspend them.
users.noMatchesBody: Try another email, role or status.
users.emptyBody: People appear here after they sign in for the first time.
users.self: This is your account. Another administrator has to change your role or status.

roleHint.admin: Can also review courses, manage users and see analytics.

statusHint.active: Can sign in and use the platform.
statusHint.suspended: Can't sign in. Their courses and progress are kept.

admin.title: Make {{name}} an administrator?
admin.body: They'll be able to review courses, manage users and see analytics.

user.title: Remove {{name}}'s administrator role?
user.body: They keep their courses and learning, but lose access to administration.

suspended.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspended.body: They're signed out and can't sign in until you reactivate the account. Their courses and progress are kept.

active.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
active.body: They can sign in again and pick up where they left off.

users.claimNotSynced: The role is saved. Their app may show the old role until they next sign in.
users.sessionsNotRevoked: The account is suspended. Sessions that are already open end within an hour; the platform refuses their requests now.

videos.title: Unavailable videos
videos.description: Videos that YouTube reports as private, deleted or not embeddable, in published courses and courses under review.
videos.search: Search by course, video or owner
videos.noMatchesBody: Try another course, video or owner.
videos.emptyBody: Videos YouTube can't play appear here after a check.

summary.aborted: Check stopped early: YouTube kept failing. Try again later.
